name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, June 04, 2019 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Segawa
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
None
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive full reading of ordinances and that they be read in title only.
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of April 16, 2019, and May 21, 2019, and the Special Meeting of May 21, 2019.
Item #7b
c.
Approval of Warrants/Payroll Register
Item #7c
d.
ORD 801 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 11-1.49.02 (PRINCIPAL USES PERMITTED) 11-1.49.04 (PERMITTED USES BY CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT), AND 11-1.49.05 (PROHIBITED USES) OF THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL (D-C) ZONE. INITIATED BY THE CITY OF LOMITA. (Second Reading)
Item #7d
e.
Consideration of a Resolution of Public Convenience and Necessity Relative to Conditional Use Permit No. 310, for the sale of beer and wine for the property located at 2301 Pacific Coast Highway in the C-R (Commercial Retail) Zone.
Item #7e
f.
Consideration of approval of a Revised Comp Plan for Non-Represented Employees.
Item #7f
g.
Consideration of an award for construction inspection services to LAE Associates, Inc., for the Walnut Street Water Main Project.
1.
Approve an amended total project budget of $1,869,336.48; and
2.
Award a Professional Services Agreement to LAE Associates, Inc. for Construction Management, Construction Inspection and Material Testing Services for the Construction of the Walnut Street Water Main Replacement and Street Rehabilitation Project in the amount of $133,200 plus a 10% contingency amount of $13,320; and
3.
Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENTS/REAPPOINTMENTS TO PLANNING AND PUBLIC SAFETY TRAFFIC COMMISSIONS
Presented by Kathleen Hill, City Clerk
a)
One vacant seat on the Planning Commission with a term ending June 2020
b)
Two expired terms on the Planning Commission
c)
One expired term on the Public Safety and Traffic Commission
Item #8
PUBLIC HEARINGS
9.
PUBLIC HEARING – CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-20
Presented by Carla Dillon, P.E., Public Works Director
#9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, June 18, 2019, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
